item.title: Why Did Government Ban 30 OTT Platforms in India Including Ullu, MoodXVIP and Desiflix?
item.description: India's MIB has blocked 30 OTT platforms, including Ullu, newcomers MoodXVIP and Digi Movieplex, for hosting obscene and vulgar content. The ban follows violations of the IT Act and Indecent Representation of Women Act. Authorities cited 'domain hopping' and a lack of artistic merit as key reasons for the crackdown on these apps.
